title: 70 OFWs from Saudi Arabia return home amid Middle East tensions

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Seventy overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) from Saudi Arabia have returned safely to the Philippines as tensions in the Middle East continue to escalate, the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) said. In a statement on Saturday, the DMW said the OFWs arrived at Ninoy Aquino International Airport (Naia) Terminal 3 in Pasay City on Nov. 13 aboard a Qatar Airways flight. So far, 1,170 OFWs and their dependents have returned from Saudi Arabia through the facilitation of the DMW and the Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (Owwa).
